memoryBuilder.phrase: Love your neighbour — go and help!
memoryBuilder.verseText: Jesus said: 'Go and do the same.'

sequence.prompt: What happened on the road to Jericho? Put it in order.

items.label: A man is hurt on the road
He takes the man to safety

matches.prompt: Match each person to what they did.

application.question: Jesus said your neighbour is anyone who needs your help. Who could you be a good neighbour to this week?
application.followUp: Your neighbour can be any of those people — anyone who needs you to stop and help. Go and do the same, just like the Good Samaritan!
